pairs.english: The man Nerai found

pairs.target: zài huò tī běibiān xiū zhìdòngqì .
pairs.english: repaired brakes north of the freight lift.

pairs.target: yuē de shì sāntiān hòu shōugōng .
pairs.english: The appointment was after work three days later.

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tíqián xǐ le shǒu ,
pairs.english: Tavi washed his hands beforehand,
but black grime remained under his nails.
He scrubbed hard with a rag.
Sela saw him

pairs.target: jiào tā bié bǎ pí cuō pò ,
pairs.english: and told him not to rub his skin raw,

pairs.target: yòu wǎng tā kǒudài lǐ sāi le bànkuài bǐng .
pairs.english: then stuffed half a flatbread into his pocket.
pairs.hanzi: 又往他口袋里塞了半块饼。

pairs.english: “Eat if you're hungry.
Don't wait for someone to ask.”
By the time he reached the north side,
only a corner of the flatbread remained,
hidden beneath his papers,

pairs.target: zěnme ná dōu yào diào xiè .
pairs.english: shedding crumbs however he held it.

pairs.target: xiūlǐ jiān lǐ yǒu gǔ yóujiān guò shìde qìwèi .
pairs.english: The workshop smelled of oil that had been used for frying.
pairs.hanzi: 修理间里有股油煎过似的气味。

pairs.target: yìzhī chāikāi de zhìdòng gǔ héng zài mùjià shàng ,
pairs.english: A dismantled brake drum lay across a wooden stand,
pairs.hanzi: 一只拆开的制动鼓横在木架上，

pairs.target: bǐ jiālǐ de zào hái dà .
pairs.english: bigger even than their stove at home.

pairs.target: nánrén zhèng cóng gǔ nèi qǔchū jiù diànpiàn ,
pairs.english: The man was removing an old shim from inside the drum,
pairs.hanzi: 男人正从鼓内取出旧垫片，

pairs.english: his left glove worn through in two places,
his right hand bare.
Nerai stood by the door

pairs.target: méiyǒu tì tǎ wéi bǎ zhǐ dìguòqù .
pairs.english: and did not hand over Tavi's papers for him.
pairs.hanzi: 没有替塔维把纸递过去。

pairs.english: “This is Rutzen,”
she said.
The man did not look up.
“Don't come forward yet.
That rod on the floor is about to move.”
Tavi stopped.

pairs.target: yìmíng xuétú bān xià qiángbiān de chángbǐng ,
pairs.english: An apprentice pulled down the long handle by the wall;
pairs.hanzi: 一名学徒扳下墙边的长柄，

pairs.english: the iron rod slid along the floor,

pairs.target: gānghǎo sǎo guò tā běnlái yào luòjiǎo de dìfāng .
pairs.english: sweeping precisely where he had been about to step.
pairs.hanzi: 刚好扫过他本来要落脚的地方。

pairs.target: lǔ cén jiāng diànpiàn fàngjìn pén lǐ ,
pairs.english: Rutzen put the shim into a basin
before taking off his glove.

pairs.target: tā de shǒu bǐ tǎ wéi xiǎng de pǔtōng .
pairs.english: His hands were more ordinary than Tavi had imagined.
pairs.hanzi: 他的手比塔维想的普通。

pairs.english: Thick knuckles,
nails cut extremely short,

pairs.target: mǔzhǐ shàng yǒu yídào jiù bā ,
pairs.english: an old scar across one thumb—
they neither glowed
nor had an extra finger.

pairs.target: " yǐwéi qiānzì de rén dōu dàibái shǒutào ? "
pairs.english: “Think everyone who signs papers wears white gloves?”
Tavi's face warmed.

pairs.target: lǔ cén yòng xiàbā zhǐ le zhǐ zhìdòng gǔ .
pairs.english: Rutzen nodded towards the brake drum.
pairs.hanzi: 鲁岑用下巴指了指制动鼓。

pairs.target: " zhè dōngxī búhuì yīnwèi wǒ yào kǎo nǐ ,
pairs.english: “This thing won't, just because I'm assessing you,
repair itself.
Wait while I wash my hands.”
A row of brass bells hung on the wall,

pairs.target: měi zhī xiàmiàn shuānzhe bùtóng yánsè de xiàn .
pairs.english: a differently coloured cord tied beneath each one.
pairs.hanzi: 每只下面拴着不同颜色的线。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tīngjiàn qízhōng yìzhī xiǎng le liǎngxià ,
pairs.english: Tavi heard one of them ring twice,
pairs.hanzi: 塔维听见其中一只响了两下，

pairs.english: and the apprentice went to the doorway

pairs.target: bǎ yíkuài mùpái fān le miàn .
pairs.english: to turn over a wooden sign.
People here didn't need to run outside

pairs.target: yě zhīdào shàngmiàn yǒurén zài děng .
pairs.english: to know someone was waiting above.
After turning the sign, the apprentice
returned and rolled his sleeves higher.

pairs.target: tā kànzhe tǎ wéi shǒulǐ de zhǐ ,
pairs.english: He looked at the papers in Tavi's hands

pairs.target: xiǎoshēng wèn shìbushì lái zhǎo huó .
pairs.english: and quietly asked if he was looking for work.
“For an assessment.”
“Oh.”
The apprentice made room at the table

pairs.target: yòu bǎ zìjǐ zuò de dèngzǐ tīguòqù yìdiǎn ,
pairs.english: and nudged his own stool over with a foot.
pairs.hanzi: 又把自己坐的凳子踢过去一点，

pairs.english: “This one doesn't wobble.
The other one's missing a nail;
I keep forgetting to replace it.”
Rutzen returned
and read the record first.
Seeing the corrected “numb hands,”

pairs.target: tā bǎ zhǐ zhuǎnxiàng tǎ wéi .
pairs.english: he turned the paper towards Tavi.
“What about today?”
“None.”
He had Tavi close his eyes,

pairs.target: jiāng yìgēn yuántóu mù qiān qīngqīng dǐ zài bùtóng de zhǐ fù shàng ,
pairs.english: gently touching a round-tipped wooden stick to different fingertips,
pairs.hanzi: 将一根圆头木签轻轻抵在不同的指腹上，

pairs.target: wèn pèng de shì nǎ gēn shǒuzhǐ .
pairs.english: asking which finger he had touched.

pairs.target: yòu ràng tā jiǎnqǐ sānkē dàxiǎo bùtóng de luómào ,
pairs.english: Then he had him pick up three nuts of different sizes
pairs.hanzi: 又让他捡起三颗大小不同的螺帽，

pairs.english: and return them one by one to a shallow dish.
Tavi did it quickly.
The third clinked against the edge;
he quickly steadied it.
Rutzen neither praised him
nor frowned,

pairs.target: zhī bǎ qiǎndié yí dào pángbiān .
pairs.english: only moved the shallow dish aside.
On the table lay two short iron strips,

pairs.target: gèzì jià zài liǎngkuài mù diàn shàng .
pairs.english: each resting on two wooden supports.
Copper weights loaded their centres;

pairs.target: hòumiàn shù zhe kèxiàn de báibǎn ,
pairs.english: behind them stood a white board marked with lines,

pairs.target: gēn nài lěi nàcì de bǎifǎ hěn xiàng .
pairs.english: much like Nerai's earlier arrangement.
pairs.hanzi: 跟奈蕾那次的摆法很像。

pairs.english: “You've done this before.
I'm not changing the task,”
Rutzen said.
“Make it move a little.
When I tap the table,
let go.
Stop even if nothing moves.”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kàn le nài lěi yìyǎn .
pairs.english: Tavi glanced at Nerai.

pairs.target: tā zài ménbiān zhǎo le gè dìfāng zuòxià ,
pairs.english: She found a place to sit by the door,
pairs.hanzi: 她在门边找了个地方坐下，

pairs.target: jiāng zìjǐ de bāo bào zài xī shàng .
pairs.english: holding her bag on her knees.
He positioned both hands.
The first time,
nothing happened.
Rutzen tapped the table;
he let go,
two traces of coolness lingering on his palms.
“Try again?”
Tavi nodded.

pairs.target: lǔ cén wèn guò tā de shǒu ,
pairs.english: Rutzen asked about his hands,
straightened the copper weights again,
and told him to sit for a while first.
The apprentice brought water

pairs.target: shùnshǒu bǎ tā cáng zài zhǐ xià de bǐng jiǎo nuókāi .
pairs.english: and moved aside the bread corner he'd hidden beneath the papers.
pairs.hanzi: 顺手把他藏在纸下的饼角挪开。

pairs.target: " zhège bié gēn tiěxiè fàng yìqǐ . "
pairs.english: “Don't keep this with the iron shavings.”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ bǐng chī le ,
pairs.english: Tavi ate the bread,

pairs.target: juéde yànxiàqù de shēngyīn tài xiǎng .
pairs.english: feeling that his swallowing sounded too loud.
pairs.hanzi: 觉得咽下去的声音太响。

pairs.english: The second time,

pairs.target: tā xiān chájué zuǒbiān xiàng yǒu yìdiǎn sōngdòng .
pairs.english: he first sensed a slight yielding on the left.
pairs.hanzi: 他先察觉左边像有一点松动。

pairs.english: The edge in front of the white board sank;
the strip on the right rose a fraction.
He watched it,
a sudden brightness inside him:
he could do a little more.
A little more,
and anyone would be able to see it.
A tap sounded on the table.
He heard it.

pairs.target: kě nàtiáo xìxiàn zhèngyào yuèguò xià yídào kèhén ,
pairs.english: But that fine line was about to cross the next mark,
pairs.hanzi: 可那条细线正要越过下一道刻痕，

pairs.target: tā de shǒu hái liú zhe .
pairs.english: and his hands stayed.

pairs.target: děng nài lěi jiào chū tā de míngzì ,
pairs.english: Only when Nerai called his name
did he jerk his hands away.
The copper weight wobbled
but did not fall.
Both iron strips slowly returned to their original positions.
pairs.hanzi: 两条铁片慢慢回到原处。

pairs.english: Rutzen removed the white board.
“That's all for today.”
Tavi reached for the nuts,

pairs.target: xiǎng zhèngmíng zìjǐ hái néng jiǎn .
pairs.english: wanting to prove he could still pick them up.
He grasped the first,

pairs.target: què méi fēnqīng pèng zhe de shì léng háishì píngmiàn .
pairs.english: but couldn't tell whether he was touching an edge or a flat face.
pairs.hanzi: 却没分清碰着的是棱还是平面。

pairs.target: nà kē luómào cóng zhǐ jiān gǔnjìn dié lǐ .
pairs.english: The nut rolled from his fingers into the dish.
pairs.hanzi: 那颗螺帽从指间滚进碟里。

pairs.target: zhèhuí méi rén děng tā zài shì .
pairs.english: This time nobody waited for him to try again.
“I was only a little slow,”
he said.
Rutzen laid his hand on the table

pairs.target: yòng shízhǐ qīngqīng qiāo le yíxià .
pairs.english: and tapped lightly with his forefinger.
“I told you to stop,

pairs.target: búshì jiào nǐ zuò dé gèng míngxiǎn . "
pairs.english: not to make it more obvious.”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dīng zhe nàgēn shǒuzhǐ ,
pairs.english: Tavi stared at that finger,

pairs.target: xiǎng shuō gāngcái yǐjīng kuài chéng le ,
pairs.english: wanting to say he had almost succeeded,
the words on his lips,

pairs.target: què xiǎngqǐ dìshàng huá guò de tiěgǎn .
pairs.english: but he remembered the iron rod sliding across the floor.
pairs.hanzi: 却想起地上滑过的铁杆。

pairs.target: nà dōngxī búhuì děng tā juéde gòu le zài tíng .
pairs.english: That thing would not wait until he felt he'd done enough to stop.
pairs.hanzi: 那东西不会等他觉得够了再停。

pairs.target: lǔ cén zài zhǐ shàng xiě wán ,
pairs.english: Rutzen finished writing on the paper
and set down his pen.
“I saw the change.
Your stopping wasn't adequate;
I can't sign today.
In four days,
at the same time,
you can come again.

pairs.target: shǒu méi huīfù jiù bú zuò ,
pairs.english: If your hands haven't recovered, you don't do it.

pairs.target: búyòng wèile gǎn rìzi mán zhe . "
pairs.english: Don't hide it to meet a deadline.”
“Only a few days left,”
Tavi said quietly.
“Then you should be all the clearer
what to practise next.”
As they left,

pairs.target: nài lěi tì tā lākāi chénzhòng de mén ,
pairs.english: Nerai pulled the heavy door open for him,
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾替他拉开沉重的门，

pairs.english: but did not carry his papers.

pairs.target: tā yòng hái néng fēnqīng lěngrè de zhǎngxīn jiázhù zhǐbiān ,
pairs.english: He held the paper's edge between palms that could still distinguish warmth from cold,
pairs.hanzi: 他用还能分清冷热的掌心夹住纸边，

pairs.english: and only once outside did he ask:
“You think he shouldn't sign either?”
“Yes.”

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu bǎ nàge zì shuō qīng .
pairs.english: She did not soften the word.

pairs.target: liǎng rén yán qiáng zǒu le yíduàn ,
pairs.english: They walked a little way along the wall.

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ zhǐ dìgěi tā ,
pairs.english: Tavi handed her the paper

pairs.target: qǐng tā niàn lǔ cén xiěxià de nà yìháng .
pairs.english: and asked her to read the line Rutzen had written.
pairs.hanzi: 请她念鲁岑写下的那一行。

pairs.english: He listened to the end,

pairs.target: yòu qǐng tā niàn le yícì .
pairs.english: then asked her to read it again.
